description.value: Esquimalt Roasting Company is a small-batch specialty coffee roastery that roasts its beans on-site in the Esquimalt neighbourhood of Victoria, British Columbia. The ERC Gateway café at 854 Esquimalt Road is one of two physical locations where customers can enjoy freshly roasted single-origin and blended coffees. Beans are also available for online purchase with delivery across BC and Canada, reflecting the roastery's community-focused, locally rooted ethos.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 34m; stands (3 spaces) at 45m; rack (4 spaces) at 99m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms two physical café locations; the ERC GATEWAY at 854 Esquimalt Rd #101 matches this OSM record. The website supplies a phone number (236-896-0575) absent from OSM and lists the postal code as V9A 3M4, whereas OSM has V9A 0L2 — a discrepancy flagged in concerns. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM has V9A 0L2, website shows V9A 3M4 for the ERC GATEWAY location at 854 Esquimalt Rd #101. Website value used in address field.
Phone number (236-896-0575) is present on the website for ERC GATEWAY but was absent from OSM tags.
This business operates a second café location ('Town Square' Cafe at #102-505 Park Place, Victoria) — that location may warrant a separate OSM record and directory entry.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active specialty coffee café and roastery with a confirmed physical location matching the OSM record; publicly accessible to all customers.
